summary: Iteration 3: Coordinator CSV control + trophy-poster backgrounds. Backend: 39/39 pass (new test_csv_export_control.py 9/9; updated outdated test_export_scoping to new can_export rule; 1 flaky attendance test passes serially). can_export defaults false, coordinator export 403 -> PATCH true -> 200 with only KALOOR(br-1) rows -> PATCH false -> 403; /auth/me returns can_export; super admin always 200; scanner 403 even with can_export=true; coordinator cannot PATCH self (403). Frontend at 390x844: landing trophy background, centered readable OLAM 3.0, no overlapping buttons (also OK at 375x667); register/my-pass/confirmation/staff-login show ivory panel over artwork, no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=390); pass page readable on dark bg. Staff Management CSV toggle flips Allowed/Not allowed and persists after reload. Coordinator dashboard shows dashboard-export-btn when allowed (real download, 30 lines, only KALOOR) and dashboard-export-disabled text when not (updates on reload via /auth/me). Regression: UI registration -> confirmation (OLM-C71F44) and admin/coordinator login -> dashboard work. No deprecated Expo packages found.

issues: dashboard-logout-btn ('Sign out') touch target is 50x16px, below the 44x44 minimum
Gold (#D4AF37-ish) eyebrow labels (e.g. 'EVENT REGISTRATION', 'REGISTRATION RECEIVED', 'STATUS') on ivory panel have low contrast (~2:1); consider a darker gold for text on light surfaces
Bottom dark text block (rgba(0,0,0,0.72)) starts with a hard horizontal edge across the trophy pedestal; a gradient fade would look smoother (cosmetic)

Sticky Submit footer covers chips scrolled to the bottom edge (seen when the batch row is just above the footer); real users can scroll, but adding paddingBottom equal to footer height in the ScrollView content avoids it

action_items: Optional: darker gold for small eyebrow text on ivory panels for contrast
Optional: staff CSV toggle — add accessibilityRole='switch' + accessibilityState, show an error toast if PATCH fails (currently it silently refreshes)
critical_code_review_comments: manage.tsx toggleExport uses the stale 's' closure; fast double-taps send the same value twice. Low impact
No DELETE /api/staff endpoint; test staff can only be deactivated via the API (cleanup was done through cleanup_test_data.py on the DB)
export_regs runs 2 DB queries per row (branch + attendance); fine at this scale but would be slow with thousands of rows
